header: Pure helpers (no database/model imports) for QUESTIONS WITH TWO PARTS, e.g. "how many restricted holidays can category B take in 2025 and which of them fall in November". The structured holiday engine answers only one thing. Without this, the second part was silently dropped and the answer looked complete. Now I tell the person what was not answered.

symbols.name: SECOND_Q_RE
doc: A connector that starts a SECOND question: "... and which ...", "..., also what ...", "...; show ...", "...? list ...". I require the connector to be followed by an interrogative / request word, so "March and April", "restricted and festival", "compare 2024 and 2025" are NOT treated as two questions.

symbols.name: findSecondQuestion
symbols.sig: export function findSecondQuestion(raw: string): string | null
doc: Returns the text of the second question, or null when the query has only one part.

symbols.name: coveredByDetails
symbols.sig: export function coveredByDetails(second: string, details: HolidayDetail[] | undefined): boolean
doc: True when the answer card ALREADY contains what the second part asks for, so I need no "not answered" note: who it applies to (the card shows categories), why (the card shows the reason), or its type.
